title: (No AI) Over 1 million people have clicked LinkedIn’s AI slop button
author: Jay Peters
content:
![A screenshot of LinkedIn’s “Seems like AI slop” button.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/07/1785424232227.jpeg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

LinkedIn actually announced a "Seems like AI slop" button on July 30th, and the company says that a lot of people have already used it. According to a Thursday post from [chief product officer Hari Srinivasan](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7495960472341409792/), "over a million people" have clicked on the button, which is accessible from the three dots menu on a post.

LinkedIn announced the button a few weeks after AI detector Pangram [determined that](https://www.pangram.com/blog/ai-in-your-feed?ref=404media.co) 41 percent of LinkedIn's longform posts were flagged as fully AI generated, [which _404 Media_ reported on](https://www.404media.co/linkedin-and-x-are-flooded-with-ai-spam-browsing-data-suggests/). Alongside the AI slop button, LinkedIn introduced "new and improved" classifiers to identify posts as AI and removed a feature that would "en …

title: (No AI) Major YouTube creators are facing backlash for accepting AI money
author: Charles Pulliam-Moore
content:
YouTube" data-portal-copyright="Screenshot: The Verge, [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CGoFUxCmBdA)" data-has-syndication-rights="1" src="https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/ai-label\_eb9dbb.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100" />

A still from Sam Kolder’s video “AI is replacing me.” | Screenshot: The Verge, [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CGoFUxCmBdA)

Over the past few days, a number of prominent filmmaking content creators including [Matti Haapoja](https://www.threads.com/@mattih/post/DcBh3cslYcg) and [Sam "Kold" Kolder](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CGoFUxCmBdA) have posted videos of themselves demonstrating what's possible with [AI platform Higgsfield](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/977994/higgsfield-ai-cully-hill-boys-black-list). The videos highlight Higgsfield's recently added [Seedance 2.5 functionality](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/974018/pippa-seedance-artist-royalties) and pitch these technologies as the future of video production.

In response to these videos, other creators [started sharing](https://www.threads.com/@chrislawley_/post/DcFuT60Gwry) what appear to be [screenshots of partnership offers](https://www.threads.com/@geraldundone/post/DcFRjUfDF0Q) they'd received from PR firms working on Higgsfield's behalf. All of this led fans to the conclusion that Higgsfield has been trying to use creators to boost its profile and garner goo …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/983181/matti-haapoja-sam-kold-kolder-higgsfield-seedance-backlash)
